[FI] Shall we practice some more? I can teach you 
again.

TEXT: [FI] Ahaha... that cut a little too deep, didn't it~?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] How come this knife is suddenly cutting so well?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] The fault doesn't lie with the tool.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
[FI] By the waaay, why are we making meat and 
potato stew again?

TEXT: [FI] Isn't it pointless to keep making the same thing?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=24]That's no good, to think like that.[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:

then you can talk.

TEXT: [FI] Ah, see? You've cut it too much again.

TEXT: [FI] ...I wonder if I'm not cut out for cooking.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] It's still 10 years too early to talk like that~

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] Hmm... This is just a hypothetical question... but 
Kanako-chan?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] What would you think if I said "I'm slow and not 
suited for things like dancing or singing"?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
[FI] I'm sorry Master, but what you just said was 
pretty stupid.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
[FI] Those are words only someone whose practiced a 
hundred times over can say, you know.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] It's the same thing. If you've really got the passion, 
then be quiet and practice.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] Maybe we need to start from the basics again, 
huh? Wait here, I'll go grab a first-aid kit.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:

cleaning up.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] You're going to Kyou-chan's home again tomorrow, 
right?
